name: Nostalgic 1999
source:
A comedic - and grounded - visual novel set before the turn of the new millennium. 

Four people's lives will intertwine for the first time. This is a story of their misadventures and how their relationships will unravel.

[From [url=https://phantom-gd.itch.io/nostalgic1999]itch.io[/url]]
